title: Shanghai hosts the 2022 World Artificial Intelligence Conference, 1 to 3 September, with about 100 forums
summary: CNR reports the event runs under the theme of an intelligently connected world, with five overseas sub-venues linked in.

title: Shenzhen publishes its AI Industry Promotion Regulations, due to take effect 1 November
summary: Yicai reports the regulations are described as China's first special legislation on the AI industry.

title: Forbes reports Stability AI in talks to raise funding at a valuation of up to USD 1bn
summary: The Forbes article dated 7 September concerns the maker of Stable Diffusion.

title: GM's Cruise will expand robotaxi service to Phoenix and Austin, Bloomberg reports
summary: The Bloomberg article dated 12 September gives a timeline of within three months.

title: Meta moves the PyTorch AI framework to the Linux Foundation
summary: Axios reported the move on 12 September.

title: Spain's cabinet starts the process to choose a headquarters for its AI supervisory agency, AESIA
summary: Sixteen provinces applied, and the government chose a building in A Coruña.

title: Nvidia, Arm and Intel propose an open, licence-free 8-bit floating-point format for AI training
summary: TechCrunch reported the whitepaper on 14 September.

title: NIH announces USD 130M over four years for Bridge2AI to speed AI use in biomedical research
summary: CSET's 22 September newsletter lists the programme among September announcements.

title: Biden executive order adds effects on US leadership in AI and microelectronics to CFIUS investment-review factors
summary: The order of 15 September gives the CFIUS panel additional national-security factors to consider.

title: Nvidia launches the RTX 4090 GPU and new services for training large language models
summary: TechCrunch reported both launches on 20 September.

title: OpenAI releases Whisper speech-recognition model with a paper on large-scale weak supervision
summary: The paper is titled 'Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision'.

title: Shanghai legislature adopts China's first provincial-level local AI regulation, effective 1 October
summary: The Standing Committee of the Shanghai Municipal People's Congress passed the regulation on promoting the AI industry.

title: OpenAI opens DALL-E 2 to all users without a waitlist, Russian-language reports say
summary: SecurityLab reports DALL-E 2 became available to everyone in late September after a limited beta.

title: Tesla shows Optimus humanoid robot prototype at AI Day; Musk says it could cost under USD 20,000
summary: Rozetked reports the prototype walked and waved without support, and Musk said production might start the following year.
